# Human Rights Campaign

> The leading national LGBTQ+ equality organization advancing legal protections, advocacy, and community organizing across all 50 states since 1980.

HRC provides comprehensive resources for LGBTQ+ rights including state-by-state guides with legal protections, anti-discrimination information, volunteer opportunities, and local steering committees. The organization combines legislative advocacy, community organizing, and educational initiatives to advance equal rights and safety for LGBTQ+ individuals nationwide.

## Key Topics

- LGBTQ+ equality
- Legal protections
- Anti-discrimination
- State legislation
- Equal rights
- Volunteer opportunities
- Advocacy resources
- State scorecards
- Healthcare access
- Community organizing
- HRC Foundation
- Vote Equal
- Vote Safe
- No Hate In My State
- Equality Impact Hub

## State Guides & Local Resources

- [HRC | Alabama](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/alabama): Alabama state guide with local programs, events, and volunteer opportunities
- [HRC | Alaska](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/alaska): Alaska state guide featuring legal protections and community organizing resources
- [HRC | Arizona](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/arizona): Arizona state guide with scorecard, legal protections, and volunteer opportunities
- [HRC | Arkansas](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/arkansas): Arkansas state guide covering legislation, legal protections, and local advocacy
- [HRC | California](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/california): California state guide with Los Angeles steering committee and advocacy resources
- [HRC | Colorado](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/colorado): Colorado state guide with steering committee and legal protections information
- [HRC | Connecticut](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/connecticut): Connecticut state guide with New England steering committee and equal rights resources
- [HRC | Delaware](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/delaware): Delaware state guide with anti-discrimination resources and legal protections
- [HRC | District of Columbia](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/washington-dc): Washington D.C. guide with Greater Washington D.C. steering committee and advocacy
- [HRC | Florida](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/florida): Florida state guide with Orlando and South Florida steering committees
- [HRC | Georgia](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/georgia): Georgia state guide with Atlanta steering committee and community action resources
- [HRC | Hawaii](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/hawaii): Hawaii state guide with equality legislation and legal protections information
- [HRC | Idaho](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/idaho): Idaho state guide covering employment discrimination, housing rights, and protections
- [HRC | Illinois](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/illinois): Illinois state guide with Chicago steering committee and equal rights legislation
- [HRC | Indiana](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/indiana): Indiana state guide addressing employment discrimination and healthcare access
- [HRC | Iowa](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/iowa): Iowa state guide with legal protections and volunteer advocacy opportunities
- [HRC | Kansas](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/kansas): Kansas state guide with Kansas City steering committee and state legislation info
- [HRC | Kentucky](https://www.hrc.org/in-your-area/kentucky): Kentucky state guide with scorecard, legal protections, and advocacy resources
